sentences.english: The Teacher's Day is coming soon.

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì duì Xiǎomíng shuō: "Zài guò jǐ tiān jiùshì jiàoshī jié le, wǒmen gěi Wáng lǎoshī zhǔnbèi yī fèn lǐwù ba!"
sentences.english: Lili said to Xiaoming, "In a few days, it will be Teacher's Day. Let's prepare a gift for Teacher Wang!"

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Hǎo zhǔyì! Kěshì sòng shénme hǎo ne?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "Good idea! But what should we give?"

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiǎngle xiǎng, shuō: "Wǒmen kěyǐ zìjǐ zuò yī zhāng kǎpiàn, zài cóng huāyuán lǐ zhāi yīxiē xīnxiān de huā."
sentences.english: Lili thought for a moment and said, "We can make a card ourselves and pick some fresh flowers from the garden."

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng gāoxìng de shuō: "Tài hǎo le! Wǒ zuì xǐhuān Wáng lǎoshī le, tā jiāo wǒmen Hànyǔ, duì wǒmen zhēn hǎo."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said happily, "Great! I like Teacher Wang the most. She teaches us Chinese and is very kind to us."

sentences.pinyin: Xiàwǔ, liǎng gè háizi kāishǐ zuò kǎpiàn.
sentences.english: In the afternoon, the two children started making the card.

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì bāng Xiǎomíng zài kǎpiàn shàng xiězì: "Lǎoshī, xièxie nín! Zhù nín jiàoshī jié kuàilè!"
sentences.english: Lili helped Xiaoming write on the card: "Teacher, thank you! Wishing you a happy Teacher's Day!"

sentences.pinyin: Xiě wán yǐhòu, tāmen yīqǐ qù huāyuán zhāi huā.
sentences.english: After writing, they went to the garden to pick flowers together.

sentences.pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ de huā yòu hóng yòu bái, piàoliang jí le.
sentences.english: The flowers in the garden were red and white, extremely beautiful.

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng xiǎoxīn de zhāile shí duǒ huā, Lìlì bǎ tāmen fàng zài yīqǐ.
sentences.english: Xiaoming carefully picked ten flowers, and Lili put them together.

sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshī jié nàtiān zǎoshang, tāmen zǎozǎo de láidào xuéxiào.
sentences.english: On the morning of Teacher's Day, they arrived at school early.

sentences.pinyin: Kàndào Wáng lǎoshī, liǎng gè rén yīqǐ shuō: "Lǎoshī, zhù nín jiérì kuàilè! Zhè shì wǒmen zìjǐ zuò de kǎpiàn, háiyǒu gāng cóng huāyuán lǐ zhāi de huā."
sentences.english: Seeing Teacher Wang, the two said together, "Teacher, wishing you a happy holiday! This is a card we made ourselves, and also flowers just picked from the garden."

sentences.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī jiēguò lǐwù, xiào le.
sentences.english: Teacher Wang accepted the gift and smiled.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàozhe shuō: "Xièxie nǐmen! Qíshí, duì lǎoshī lái shuō, zuì hǎo de lǐwù jiùshì kànzhe xuéshēngmen xuéxí hé zhǎngdà. Nǐmen yuè lái yuè nǔlì, lǎoshī jiù yuè kāixīn."
sentences.english: She smiled and said, "Thank you! Actually, for a teacher, the best gift is to see students learning and growing up. The harder you work, the happier the teacher will be."

sentences.pinyin: Tīngle lǎoshī de huà, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
sentences.english: After hearing the teacher's words, Xiaoming and Lili felt very proud.

sentences.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng yǐhòu yào gèng rènzhēn de xuéxí.
sentences.english: They decided to study more seriously in the future.

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Wǒ yǐhòu měitiān dōu yào fùxí shēngcí!"
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "I will review new words every day from now on!"

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì yě xiàozhe shuō: "Wǒ yěshì! Ràng wǒmen yīqǐ jiāyóu ba!"
sentences.english: Lili also smiled and said, "Me too! Let's work hard together!"

sentences.pinyin: Cóng nà yǐhòu, liǎng gè háizi tiāntiān rènzhēn xuéxí, Wáng lǎoshī měitiān dōu hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: From then on, the two children studied hard every day, and Teacher Wang was happy every day.
